title: Чудотворные рыцари за границей
alt: Чудотворные рыцари за границей / Ronin Warriors Gaiden / Samurai Troopers OVA 1 Ronin Warriors Gaiden 鎧伝サムライトルーパー外伝
description: Things have calmed down considerably since the defeat of Talpa.​ Sage has gone off to America to study; Ryou is celebrating his birthday; Kento's won the lottery! However,​ the joyous mood disappears when the local news breaks a story about a strange killer in New York wearing mysterious armor.​ When the four warriors arrive to investigate,​ they are met by a new sinister force.​ The ancient sorcerer Shikaisen has discovered the power of the armors and is now intent on making them his own. (Source: Bandai Entertainment)

en:
Things have calmed down considerably since the defeat of Talpa.​ Sage has gone off to America to study; Ryou is celebrating his birthday; Kento's won the lottery! However,​ the joyous mood disappears when the local news breaks a story about a strange killer in New York wearing mysterious armor.​ When the four warriors arrive to investigate,​ they are met by a new sinister force.​ The ancient sorcerer Shikaisen has discovered the power of the armors and is now intent on making them his own.



(Source: Bandai Entertainment)
